known_limitations: The two product-observation analyses use deterministic realistic synthetic gaze surrogates rather than independently licensed empirical human data.
The public namespace is large; the audit assigns review postures but does not yet activate a blanket compatibility guarantee for all 458 exports.
The current development identity is 0.12.1.dev0; no package has yet been built or qualified under a literal 1.0 release identity.
required_before_any_1_0_publication: Define and freeze the explicit public stability boundary, including treatment of experimental and compatibility APIs.
Resolve any deliberately selected deprecations with documented migration windows; do not infer them from naming aesthetics alone.

Run a release-candidate qualification cycle under the literal 1.0 version identity, including package, documentation, scientific validation, performance, product-observation and reproducibility workflows.
Verify an installed 1.0 candidate outside the source checkout before final promotion.
Use the existing fail-closed release-governance process for final publication.
recommended_nonblocking_follow_up: Repeat at least one public-only workflow on an independently licensed empirical eye-tracking dataset when redistribution and consent terms permit.
Observe whether external users encounter friction not reproduced by the deterministic case-study surrogates.
